sevastopol.discovery_method: bounded public Telegram web search/history across the retained Crimeanwind family plus one official/local primary-source family

source_policy.source_identity: Official public Telegram channel @razvozhaev of the Russian-installed Sevastopol governor
source_policy.city_scope: Sevastopol city; retrieval additionally recognizes the source-specific Russian locative 'Севастополе' only for discovery filtering
source_policy.retrieval_method: Bounded public Telegram web search through the existing PublicTelegramAdapter; no Telegram API credentials and no unrestricted web fallback
source_policy.timestamp_semantics: Telegram message <time datetime> is parsed as an absolute timestamp and normalized to UTC; edited-display time does not replace original publication time
source_policy.dedup_behavior: Same Telegram channel+message_id deduplicates to one observation; episode-level event positivity remains binary across equivalent source observations
source_policy.failure_behavior: Fetch/search failure makes configured-family coverage incomplete and retry-required; it is never treated as negative evidence
source_policy.claim_treatment: Operational claims are retained as attributed claims of the Russian-installed local authority and are not silently converted into independently verified facts; the existing attack-event methodology determines strict/sensitivity/review
